articles.title: 冷空气影响持续 四川云南西藏等地有雨雪天气
articles.highlight: 24日早晨，东北地区及山东、江苏、安徽等地部分地区出现6～10℃降温，局地降幅超过13℃。
articles.summary: 文章根据中央气象台信息，梳理11月23日至24日冷空气东移南下对中东部的影响：多地出现7～9级阵风，局地超过10级，并伴随6～10℃降温，局地降幅超过13℃。同期，内蒙古东部、东北部分地区有小雪或雨夹雪，四川西部、西藏东部有中到大雪或雨夹雪，江南、华南部分地区有中到大雨、局地暴雨。这有助于公众了解降温、大风和雨雪天气的覆盖范围与出行风险。
articles.failureAnalysis: 可核实的影响集中在大风、降温和局地雨雪，公众需关注气象预警，并防范出行和农业风险。

articles.title: Learning to leave
articles.highlight: 我的狗因分离焦虑把我困在家中；为了帮它，我必须先面对自己对“离开”的恐惧。
articles.summary: 这是 Psyche 刊出的一篇第一人称文章，作者 Tracy Strauss 讲述自己因狗的分离焦虑而长期无法出门，而在帮助狗的过程中，她不得不直面自身对离开的恐惧与创伤。文章把“离开”当作一种需要练习的生活能力，适合关心中人与宠物情绪如何彼此影响，以及如何面对恐惧的读者。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键点：帮助他人或宠物时，我们常被迫先处理自己的恐惧；“离开”可以当作一项可练习的能力，不必当成一次性的意志考验。

en.highlight: My dog's separation anxiety kept me housebound, and to help him I had to face my own fears of leaving.
en.summary: In this first-person piece for Psyche, Tracy Strauss describes being unable to leave home because of her dog's separation anxiety, and how helping him forced her to confront her own fear of leaving and her PTSD. It treats leaving as a life skill to be practiced, and is worth reading for anyone interested in how human and animal emotions mirror each other.
en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: helping another being often requires us to face our own fear first, and leaving is better treated as a practiceable skill than a one-off test of will.

articles.failureAnalysis: 来源文本仅为摘要片段，未提供实验设置、数据集和量化结果，无法判断联合建模相对基线的实际增益。就现有信息看，关键限制在于需要验证该目标是否真正改善运动解码，而非仅增加模型复杂度。
articles.sourceExcerpt: MINDWORLDMODELS: JOINTLEARNING OFMOTOR EEG REPRESENTATIONS ANDACTION-CONDITIONED WORLDDYNAMICS Weikang Qiu Yale University Zheng Huang Dartmouth College Tinglin Huang Yale University Yujun Yan Dartmouth College Rex Ying Yale University ABSTRACT Motor decoding from electroencephalography (EEG) supports non-invasive brain–computer interfaces, yet existing methods either rely on costly cue-based trials and coarse categorical labels or use pretraining objectives that do not di- rectly capture how movement unfolds, limiting their ability to learn transferable motor representations. To this end, we propose the Mind World Model (MWM), a framework that learns motor EEG representations from scalable naturalistic EEG and egocentric video without action annotations. MWM treats EEG observed up to the current frame as the latent action of a world model: a mind model en- codes the EEG, and a world model uses it to predict the representation of a future frame, yielding a movement-grounded pretraining objective.

en.highlight: Motor EEG decoding for non-invasive brain–computer interfaces is being framed as joint learning of motor representations and action-conditioned world dynamics.
en.summary: The paper targets motor decoding from EEG to support non-invasive brain–computer interfaces. It notes that existing methods either rely on costly cue-based trials and coarse categorical labels or use pretraining objectives that do not directly capture motor-related dynamics. The title indicates an attempt to jointly learn motor EEG representations and action-conditioned world dynamics.
en.failureAnalysis: The supplied text is only a partial abstract and gives no datasets, experimental setup, or quantitative results, so the actual gain over baselines cannot be assessed. The key open issue is whether the joint objective improves motor decoding rather than merely adding model complexity.

articles.title: BaaRai/ARTEX
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 该 GitHub 仓库获得 17828 stars，近期有公开活动，描述为 AI 自主渗透测试系统。它值得关注，因为高关注度显示 AI 驱动安全测试正受到开发者社区注意，且其上游项目与 AGPL-3.0 许可证会影响后续采用。
articles.failureAnalysis: 自主渗透测试直接触及授权、合规与责任边界，若缺少严格授权确认、审计日志和权限隔离，可能带来法律与安全风险。真实渗透场景对误报、漏报和可复现性要求高，AI 代理的可靠性需要长期验证。高星数不等于生产可用，AGPL-3.0 也可能限制商业集成，安全团队对自动化攻击工具的信任建立会更慢。
